high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an article from the website entrackr.com, which discusses the financial performance of WeRize, a company founded by Vishal Chopra and Himanshu Gupta. The article highlights that WeRize provides loans (mortgage and unsecured) and group insurance to the lower middle class through its own mortgage finance services and partnerships with third-party non-banking financial institutions such as Vivitri Capital and InCred. The text in the article mentions that revenue from interest and services fees accounted for 84.85% of the total operating revenue.
